capabilities: Add the currently active file to a Harpoon list of up to four files
Jump to hooked files using numbered Go To File commands
Browse, reorder, and remove hooked files in a modal
Rebind navigation hotkeys in plugin settings
extras: The plugin stores its file list in harpoon-config.json in the vault and warns against deleting it manually; README includes an unsupported request for GitHub stars and coffee donations, plus a Todos section with unfinished features.
intentEvidence: This is a port of Harpoon (github.com/theprimeagen/harpoon) plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian lacks a fixed, keyboard-first way to jump between a small set of favorite files without digging through the file list or quick switcher each time.

relations.evidence: This is a port of Harpoon (github.com/theprimeagen/harpoon) plugin for Obsidian.

summary: Keyboard-driven file navigation plugin that keeps a list of up to four frequently used files and jumps to them via numbered commands or a modal.
